latest_release.name: yt-dlp 2026.10.26
latest_release.body:
[![Installation](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Which%20file%20to%20download%3F-white.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installation "Installation instructions") [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/807245652072857610?color=blue&labelColor=555555&label=&logo=discord&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/H5MNcFW63r "Discord") [![Donate](https://img.shields.io/badge/_-Donate-red.svg?logo=githubsponsors&labelColor=555555&style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/Maintainers.md#maintainers "Donate") [![Documentation](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Docs-brightgreen.svg?style=for-the-badge&logo=GitBook&labelColor=555555)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/tree/2026.10.26#readme "Documentation") [![Nightly](https://img.shields.io/badge/Nightly%20builds-purple.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-nightly-builds/releases/latest "Nightly builds") [![Master](https://img.shields.io/badge/Master%20builds-lightblue.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-master-builds/releases/latest "Master builds") #### A description of the various files is in the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#release-files) The zipimport Unix executable and release tarball contain code licensed under ISC and MIT. The PyInstaller-bundled executables are subject to these and other licenses, all of which are compiled in [THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/f264a6cbd1f630894da0f368df00f8aae50140e0/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt) --- #### Important changes - **The minimum *required* Python version has been raised to 3.11** - Python 3.10 has reached its end-of-life as of October 2026, and yt-dlp has now removed support for it. [Read more](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16916) - **The official Windows release binaries now require Windows 10 or later.** [Read more](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16917) - Security: The recent `brotli` and `certifi` vulnerabilities have now been fully addressed in the executables - The `brotli` package bundled with the executables has been upgraded to version 1.2.1, and the `curl-cffi` package has been upgraded to version 0.17.0. These upgrades address the recent [`brotli` security vulnerability](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9v8h-qqgm-4m35) - `curl-cffi` 0.17.0 also fully addresses the recent [`certifi` security vulnerability](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2) that was already partially addressed by upgrading the `certifi` package bundled with the executables

Changelog

 #### Core changes - [Remove Python 3.10 support](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/3d28cf4780fa88689fc50010d72cf2f40ce3a3b8) ([#17160](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17160)) by [bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly), [doe1080](https://github.com/doe1080), [Grub4K](https://github.com/Grub4K) #### Extractor changes - **odnoklassniki**: [Fix boosty direct link extraction](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/fa9886678eb65103303c627b8e013f13f8999b41) ([#17749](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17749)) by [bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly) #### Networking changes - **Request Handler**: curl_cffi: [Support `curl_cffi` 0.17.x](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/7f7106cd323e17ffd3d4119250739cf1ae520cea) ([#17929](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17929)) by [bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly) (With fixes in [15262b0](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/15262b0b9813131e72236f7fc9a663407ac295b1)) #### Misc. changes - **build** - [Always use latest Python version on Windows](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/9b58cb33d0cd3e823c8d8732f6adce8faa1f37e3) ([#17901](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17901)) by [bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly) - [Update 13 dependencies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/7747073a2b00ca4688637eef4e168af9d2a806cb) ([#17924](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/
